notes.title: Minor bugfixes
notes.notes: A minor bug fixed in the main menu when changing the difficulty of the AI

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that click sounds were not played in the Encyclopedia after reloading a game

notes.title: Costs for Pipes and Walkways
notes.notes:
This update introduces costs for Pipes and Walkways. Each element costs 1t of Silicates.

Added further entries to the encyclopedia, some minor UI improvements and bugfixes.

notes.title: Encyclopedia
notes.notes:
This update adds a new in-game Encyclopedia to Asteroid Colony. Open it through the info icons on the top of the buildings details panel and spaceship details panel, and read through a number of entries. If some of these entries are not clear enough or have mistakes in them, please be so kind and report those issues!
Furthermore, a few bugs have been fixed and the Christmas tree has been removed.

notes.title: Bugfixes and UX improvements
notes.notes: This update contains several bugfixes and UX improvements. This also contains a fix for a bug because of which sometimes games could not be loaded on devices with a system language other than English.

notes.title: Christmas
notes.notes: Christmas is not only celebrated on earth, but also in human settlements in the asteroid belt. So a Christmas tree was put up in every park.

notes.title: Bugfixes and new Sound Effects
notes.notes: Fixed a few bugs and added new sound effects when clicking on Telescope or Plastic Production buildings

notes.title: Massive Load Times Improvements
notes.notes:
With this update, the load times of saved games have been speed up massively. One of our test games which took four minutes to load now loads in 36 seconds!
Additionally, a bug has been fixed where astronauts on the asteroid surface were flickering when zoomed out.

notes.title: UX Improvements
notes.notes: This release contains bugfixes and improvements to the tutorial and the user interface

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.notes: Fixed bugs with the newly introduced astronauts

notes.title: Humans enter your colonies
notes.notes:
In this update, animated human models are added to the game. As for now, they move around free areas on asteroids, and inside parks.
Thanks to the fan on the Discord server who suggested this feature!

notes.title: Street Preview
notes.notes: When building "streets" (i.e. Walkways and Pipes) you will now get a real time preview of where the street will begin, without having to click and hope for the best.

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.notes: This update brings a few bugfixes to the tutorial

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.notes: This version fixes some bugs in the New Trade Route Panel and in the tutorial

notes.title: Sound Effects
notes.notes:
This build adds many sound effects to the game. Not all buildings and events have a dedicated sound effect yet, but this should change in the future. Please share your feedback!

Additionally, a few other bugs were fixed:
[list]
[*]The game can now be saved while paused
[*]A few bugs in the intro were fixed, including that the arrows were not pointing at their targets accurately
[*]A few other minor issues
[/list]

notes.title: New Tutorial
notes.notes:
Starting a game in Asteroid Colony for the first time can be complicated. To help guide players through the first steps, a new tutorial was added to the game.

Additionally, this update fixes the "Continue Game" button in the main menu.

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.notes: Many bugfixes and additions that will make bugfixing easier in the future

notes.title: Game improvements
notes.notes:
Improvements to the AI. It will settle new asteroids in a smarter way, and build buildings in better places.
Enemy buildings can now be targeted directly when they are selected.
Many Bugfixes

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.notes: Bug fixed where errors would sometimes occur when loading a game where buildings are not connected to the street network

notes.title: Small screen optimizations
notes.notes:
The graphical user interface has been adjusted to fit better on smaller screen sizes, such as laptops.
Fixed bloom effects of bright lights.

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.notes: Fix a bug where sometimes the game would be stuck forever in the loading screen when loading a saved game

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.notes: Bug fixed where an error would occur during saving of the game

notes.title: Asteroid Colony releases into Early Access!
notes.notes:
Let's celebrate together this major milestone of Asteroid Colony! The game has just been released into early access! 

Of course, this is only one step along the path to finish the game. From now on, you can contribute to the game by providing feedback and by spreading the word! From now on, you will be able to buy and download Asteroid Colony, and give it a try.

Great thanks go out to anyone who wishlisted Asteroid Colony so far, and to all who helped out with the development until now.

notes.title: New Rocket Plume Animation
notes.notes:
Asteroid Colony is in the final spurt towards the release into Early Access! So the last improvements are currently being done, such as a complete rework of the rocket exhaust plume. 

The new plume may not look as familiar as the old one, but this comes from the fact that rocket engines in Asteroid Colony are fired exclusively in the vacuum of space. The missing air pressure allows the gasses to expand rapidly, leading to a bell shaped plume.

You can give feedback on the redesign on the [url=https://discord.gg/hrcrHQGMtG]community Discord server[/url].

notes.title: Early Access
notes.notes:
The last years of development of Asteroid Colony have been a great pleasure. Now, that the development has proceeded far enough, it is an even greater pleasure to announce the start of the Early Access phase on the [b]23rd of October[/b]! 

This is your chance to be among the first to try out Asteroid Colony at a reduced price, and to directly influence the way the development will be proceeding.

notes.title: Community Discord Server
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The community for Asteroid Colony grows every day, so the decision was made to create a Discord server to bring everyone together. Share feedback, ideas, and media with the developer and each other, and influence how the game will develop in the future.

The server was specifically started to gather feedback for the upcoming release of the first Early Access build. But of course it will remain active long afterwards for all fans to gather. You are welcome to join using this link: [url=https://discord.gg/ysX5UGTr]https://discord.gg/hrcrHQGMtG[/url]

Have a great day!

notes.title: Railgun Frigates
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Asteroid Colony now has a new type of spaceship, the [b]railgun frigate[/b].
Historically, frigates were amongst the smaller type of warships, usually used in scouting or supporting roles. They were also used in theaters far away from the mainland, where the operation of large warships would be too expensive or dangerous.
This is why this type of spaceship is a perfect fit for Asteroid Colony, where you will build and manage a civilization far off any other friendly human settlement. However, you might not be alone in space, so it is always a good idea to be able to defend oneself. And remember, a good offense is sometimes the best defense.

One of the best weapons in space combat is the railgun. The immense speeds of the projectiles make them accurate and hard to dodge. On the other hand, the rails wear quickly, and have to be replaced after every few shots. If you want to wage war seriously, you really need to have a well performing industrial complex to produce enough ammunition and replacement rails.
